title: Better Hebrew Font
description: Fixes Hebrew text by replacing the default bitmap font with Noto Sans Hebrew Condensed Bold sharp, readable, and properly sized
body:
Better Hebrew Font makes Hebrew text in Minecraft actually readable no more boxes, blurry letters, or weird spacing. All other text stays completely normal.
